rows.text: calls `00511920+0x9` with the incoming registers and returns its result when non-zero; otherwise reads three values a, b, c by the calls at `00511920+0x1F`, `+0x29` and `+0x33` (each with `r9`) and returns `002D7B40(c, b, a, 0)`

takes qword `+0x320` of the object at qword `0209AC30`; when it is non-null and `ecx` is 0 with bit 1 of its dword `+0x570` clear, calls `0055A1F0` on it and sets that bit; when it is non-null and `ecx` is non-zero with the bit set, calls `00559800` on it and clears the bit; in every other case calls `002D7580(1, 3)` and tail-jumps to `002D7580(0, 3)`

notes: 00511920: the three r9 reads are cited as +0x1F, +0x29, +0x33 from the entry 00511920 (00267E10 and 00280120 are not named by the page).
